            # to seconds so numeric and ISO timestamps can be compared.
            magnitude = abs(number)
            if magnitude >= 1e17:
                number /= 1e9
            elif magnitude >= 1e14:
                number /= 1e6
            elif magnitude >= 1e11:
                number /= 1e3
